d: A young woman's predicament forces her to marry a chief against her will. She later finds love, but there will be a hefty price to pay.
The reappearance of her ex-boyfriend causes friction between Kaima and her husband, as one wrong move leads to one bad mistake.
Patrick, Pedro, and Jessica are all deeply affected by the significant challenges they faced in their past, which have become major obstacles in their journey towards marriage.
After causing her to lose her job by wrongly accusing her of theft, Lothana tries to do everything in his power to get back in Uzoma's good graces.
